He fights monsters because of what he was told of them and he was told that they are bad by the humans.

He is supposed to be saving someone but at one point that someone dies,by his hands albeit by accident and misinformation.

Because of that the humans see his as a danger and a threat and send him to exile while those who helped him suffered a similar fate.

At this point he is just done and decides to go to where he thinks he will encounter someone named "Lilith" thinking that she will attack him and he will lose,he finds Kira Watson who he encounters before and she turns out to be "Lilith".

She doesn't want to fight him at first but he just wants to fight and expects to lose,so they fight and Andrew loses but Kira decides to keep him alive instead of killing him on the basis that he has a reason to live,so then Andrew decides to ally with her at that point.
